Definition: Ophrah, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ophrah = "fawn"; n pr m; 1) a Judaite, son of Meonothai; n pr loc; 2) a town of Benjamin approximately 5 miles (8 km) east of Bethel; 3) a place in Manasseh, native place of Gideon; probably located close to Shechem
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
